scope: full 11-probe dual-RX analysis, not batch throughput across future dwells
selection: same two metadata-selected profile cases, known positive development evidence
cores: 8 workers on CPUs0..7; 22 on CPUs0..21, including efficiency cores
baseline: current repository analyze_glrt64_dwell, ten retained candidates, CPU0
science: exact complete serialized response on every warmup and measured call
timing: CI16 conversion, one dwell shared-memory upload/create/close/unlink, per-worker probe copying, descriptor/result IPC, worker execution and serial fold included; persistent pool setup/shutdown and response validation excluded
interpretation: wall latency improvement uses more cores and does not imply CPU-work savings; two cases are not qualification
